services.name: After School
services.desc: We offer after school art classes for all ages, interests, and skill levels! Our experienced and friendly teachers focus on one-on-one instruction to develop skill, creativity, and perseverance. Please note that these dates are excluded from tuition and do not need to be madeup. Our standard class fees are $55 per 45 minute session, $60 per 1 hour session, and $80 per 90 minute session. Full semester registrations automatically receive a discount of $5 per session! Our art classes run by the semester and we encourage registering this way whenever possible to get the full experience and save a little money.
